author: Shoddy Language contributors
name: Shoddy class library wrapper
description: A class library wrapping a Shoddy mill: ShoddyWeave builds the mill into ordinary references, and the library exposes its words as .NET methods via Shoddy.Hosting.

mill.description: Path to the mill folder (holding mill.manifest), relative to the new project.

grant.description: Semicolon-separated capability grants matching the mill's manifest.

shoddyBuild.description: Path to Shoddy.Build's build/ folder (or leave for the packaged import once published).
